reasons: F01, F02, F03, F04, F06, F07: no material weakness, unqualified ICFR opinion, no going concern, no disagreements with accountants and no prior-period corrections; the control environment looks clean.

F14, F15, F16, F17, F18, F19, F20, F21, F23, F25, F26: no executive turnover, no interim CFO, no SEC or other investigations, no class action, no covenant pressure, no revenue/EPS-linked incentive pay, no capital raise, no SPAC, no voluntary accounting change and no non-GAAP emphasis, so there are few pressure or opportunity indicators.

R01, R11, R18: receivables rose much faster than sales (DSRI 1.47; AR growth exceeds sales growth by 43 points), which is a classic revenue-quality red flag. But with F22 (major acquisition in year) much of this could be acquired receivables consolidated at year-end without a full year of sales.

R19, R08, R10: operating cash flow was only 0.42x net income and accruals are positive (TATA 0.03), which points to weaker earnings quality. Working-capital build from the acquisition and inventory (R12) may explain part of this.
R09, R17: the Beneish M-score of -1.84 is just below the -1.78 threshold, and the Dechow F-score of 0.49 is well below 1.0, so the models flag only modest risk overall.

R03, R13, F22, F24: AQI rose (1.24) and soft assets are high (0.73) after a major acquisition; CAMs on business combination, goodwill/intangibles and revenue mean the purchase price allocation and intangible valuations are areas of judgement.
F10, F24: channel return rights or bill-and-hold arrangements, together with a revenue CAM, create some room for revenue-timing judgement (e.g. return allowances).

F27, R12, R02: a significant inventory writedown and a worsening gross margin (GMI 1.06) with declining sales (R04 0.90, R14 -0.15) show operating stress, but recognising the writedown is a conservative signal, not an aggressive one.
F05: the auditor changed within two years, a mild flag that is offset by F06 (no disagreements) and an unqualified ICFR opinion (F03).
guess: National Presto Industries Inc (FY2022, the year of its Woodstream acquisition)
